scripts.dev: sh -c 'echo "Agent Computer worker runs only inside the Docker image; mount TS source into the container for edit/run feedback." >&2; exit 1'
scripts.start: sh -c 'echo "Agent Computer worker runs only inside the Docker image; use the control-plane Docker worker e2e or docker run." >&2; exit 1'
scripts.lint: bun run fmt:check && bun run type-check
scripts.//test: Docker-only: Devkit consumes the control-plane container bootstrap contract, then adds the package source/test mounts and Bun command. Requires the prebuilt ankole-agent-computer image; for full runtime coverage use the control-plane Docker worker e2e.
scripts.test: cd ../.. && bun run kit agent-computer-test --suite unit
scripts.test:integration: cd ../.. && bun run kit agent-computer-test --suite integration
